known.title: Not done: A review reports new agent work that breaks a Must rule as a must-fix finding, and work that breaks a Should rule as advice.

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 3, Harm 2
Raise: Not done
Case: normal use - a signed-off client changes its agent's Markdown system prompt without changing application code.
The new instruction promises to check prompt-only edits, but src/forge/review.py:43 excludes every Markdown file from code classification, and blocking_level at lines 210–211 selects P0-only review for those changes. Unless the prompt is marked generated or directly referenced by a test, src/forge/docskip.py:17–57 treats it as documentation. The selected review-light.md omits this agents rule, and even an ordinary Agents finding with the new floor does not block at P0 level. Consequently a runtime prompt change that introduces a Must violation can pass close outside the approved prototype exception. The added test edits app.py, so it does not cover this path. Ensure runtime prompt edits receive the agents review and add a command-level case for a Markdown prompt.
